title: Mr.Boom Creepers
description: Turns Creepers into the famous Mr.Boom Cat!
body:
**Turns the creeper into the famous Mr.Boom Cat**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/f1Sp6HkncY8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


The creepers will have the Mr.Boom Texture and will play the "Boom" sound effect each time they explode instead of the default minecraft explosion sound.
If you like this resource pack, please consideer giving it a heart it helps a ton <3
